name: Masonry & Setts
description: Dressed granite for cobbled streets and the solid brick rowhouses that hold their heat.

name: Deep Mining
description: Timbered shafts and steam winches to sink mines into the iron seams.

name: Tailoring
description: Patterns for heavy leather greatcoats. Coated colonists lose heat far more slowly.

name: Steam Baking
description: A brick oven and a steam blower turn barley into bread that keeps through the winter.

name: Coal-Gas Lighting
description: Gas lamps to light the streets. Homes near a lamp are happier, and the colony comes alive at dusk.

name: Bloomery Metallurgy
description: Coal-fired furnaces reduce ore to iron, and smiths turn iron into tools.

name: Pressure Piping
description: Riveted iron mains that carry steam much farther than brick ducts, and the steam trawler that drinks it.

name: Hydraulics
description: Water mains, shore pump houses and windpumps. Boilers raise their steam from the feedwater.

name: Steam Canning
description: Steam retorts that seal food in iron tins. Tinned food never spoils.

name: Copper Metallurgy
description: Mining and smelting the green copper seams. Copper carries current and never rusts.

name: Precision Machining
description: Steam-driven lathes that cut true cogs, the heart of every engine and every clock.

name: Sanitary Science
description: Coal smoke rots the lungs. Glasshouse herbs, brewed into tonics by an apothecary, ease the coughing in the homes around it.

name: Steam Engines
description: Coal-fired boiler houses fed from the water mains, booster pumps to drive steam across town, steam tractors, and safety valves for when the boilers drink too much.

name: Lagged Mains
description: Felt lagging under copper sheathing. A lagged main carries steam across the whole town with almost no loss.

name: Steam Fire Brigade
description: A steam pump that throws water farther and faster than any bucket chain.

name: Steam Radiators
description: Cast-iron radiators and stout walls: steam tenements house twelve and need no firewood while the main reaches them.

name: Galvanism
description: Steam-turned dynamos and copper conduits: a second kind of power for the colony.

name: Arc Smelting
description: A galvanic arc melts ore without coal and yields twice the metal.

name: Electrostatic Precipitation
description: Charged copper grids pull the soot out of the air. A precipitator keeps a district breathable whatever the chimneys do.

name: Analytical Engines
description: Brass calculating engines driven by galvanic power. The Board's dearest wish.

name: Aeronautics
description: A mooring mast for the Company's airships: export your surplus for credit and order supplies from the south.

name: Steam Tramways
description: Iron rails and a steam tram depot. Citizens ride across town at three times walking pace.

name: Pneumatic Post
description: Brass tubes on the steam main shoot goods between depots, so anything delivered to one can be collected at all.

name: Clockwork Automata
description: Brass automatons that take a place in any trade and work without food or warmth. They need winding with coal and wear out in time, and the guilds whose trades they take will not thank you.
